note: Spain commonly uses 'ordenador'; Latin America uses 'computadora'.
Spain commonly uses 'coche'; much of Latin America uses 'carro'.
Spain commonly uses 'móvil'; Latin America commonly uses 'celular'.
Spain commonly uses 'zumo'; Latin America uses 'jugo'.
Spain uses 'patata'; Latin America uses 'papa' for potato.
Both mean 'to drive'; 'conducir' is more common in Spain, 'manejar' in Latin America.
Spain uses 'billete' for ticket; Latin America uses 'boleto'.
Spain uses 'judía'/'alubia' for bean; Latin America uses 'frijol'.
